about: The words every Tameru plugin interface shares, in English and Chinese. See docs/PLUGIN-UI.md. Each plugin keeps a copy and a test that its own strings equal these. {n}, {percent}, {used} and {max} are placeholders that must appear in both languages. English forbidden words match from the start of a word (so sav catches save and saving, but gain does not catch again); Chinese ones are substrings.

line.en: Nothing is shortened. Pins still work.
line.zh: 不缩短任何内容。固定内容仍然有效。

keepConfirm.en: Kept. The AI gets it at its next step.
keepConfirm.zh: 已保留。AI 将在下一步收到完整内容。

keepConfirmMessage.en: Kept. The AI gets it with your next message.
keepConfirmMessage.zh: 已保留。AI 将随你的下一条消息收到完整内容。

releaseTip.en: Kept in full. Click to let Tameru shorten it again.
releaseTip.zh: 已完整保留。点击让 Tameru 重新缩短。

releaseConfirm.en: Released. Tameru may shorten it again from the next step.
releaseConfirm.zh: 已释放。Tameru 可能从下一步起重新缩短。

releaseConfirmMessage.en: Released. Tameru may shorten it again from the next message.
releaseConfirmMessage.zh: 已释放。Tameru 可能从下一条消息起重新缩短。

placeholder.en: A rule the AI must always see…
placeholder.zh: 一条 AI 必须始终看到的规则…

empty.en: The AI sees pins in every request, word for word.
empty.zh: AI 会在每次请求中原样看到固定内容。

limit.en: {used} of {max} used. Remove one to add another.
limit.zh: 已用 {used} / {max}。移除一条后才能再添加。

notConnected.en: Cannot reach Tameru. Your chat is unchanged. Retrying every few seconds.
notConnected.zh: 无法连接 Tameru。你的对话未受影响。每隔几秒重试。

notRunning.en: Python 3.10 or newer was not found, so nothing is shortened. Your chat is unchanged. Name an interpreter in Tameru's settings.
notRunning.zh: 未找到 Python 3.10 或更新版本，因此不会缩短任何内容。你的对话未受影响。请在 Tameru 设置中指定解释器。

notRunningRetrying.en: The engine failed several times, so nothing is shortened. Your chat is unchanged. It retries within 5 minutes.
notRunningRetrying.zh: 引擎多次失败，因此不会缩短任何内容。你的对话未受影响。将在 5 分钟内重试。

problem.en: That change did not apply. Your chat is unchanged. Try again.
problem.zh: 该更改未生效。你的对话未受影响。请重试。

belowStart.en: Waiting until the context is fuller.
belowStart.zh: 等到上下文更满时再开始。

notConfident.en: Nothing could be shortened safely yet.
